contexts.text: When he was contradicted... there was something turning and creeping in the abdomen. SE 3662.
That open contradictions may be reconciled...
That no contradiction appear.
Hence there often appear contradictions (in the Word).
Light from Heaven cannot enter where there reigns such a shade from contradictory things.
Some things appear as contradictions, when yet in the Word, regarded in its own light, there is no contradiction. Example(s).
Is utterly contradictory. DP 95. DP 219:2.

To make something out of nothing is contradictory, and that which is contradictory is against the light of truth which is from the Divine wisdom, and whatever is not from the Divine wisdom is not from the Divine omnipotence.
Appears as if it were contradictory, but still is not so.
To acknowledge God and do what is evil is contradictory; also to do what is good and not to acknowledge God...

It is a contradiction to say...
Who does not see the contradiction? TCR 393:end.

Would be contradictory...
When anyone contradicts (this persuasion), he not only attacks the matter in question, but also the person.
Spirits who, from their life in the body, have acquired the delight of contradicting.
On Societies, that therein are also such as contradict or dissent from them.
I have continually observed the contradictory things of Spirits, for without contradictories there is no limited sphere.
They then contradict...

A place where there are continual contradictions.
